relations.note: Ĝatumdug supplies her favorable lamma to accompany and protect Gudea.
Bau’s Beneficent Lamma serves as her minister, intercessor, and guide.
Beneficent protective goddesses attend Inana and accompany royal power.
Inana’s joyous symbol is obscurely compared with or attributed to Bau’s Beneficent Lamma.
Protective goddesses receive offerings within temple service so Nanna accepts the king’s worship.
Protective goddesses receive offerings within temple service so Ningal accepts the king’s worship.
Aššur commands the good šēdu and lamassu to remain permanently in Sennacherib’s palace.
Ištar jointly authorizes the good šēdu and lamassu protecting Sennacherib’s palace.
Sîn entrusts good šēdu and lamassu to Adad-guppi for protection and dynastic favor.
Ninkura’s divine craft perfects the forms of Sennacherib’s bull-colossus images.
Inana creates a regional paired protective office by transforming Bilulu and Ĝirĝire.

relations.myth: Bilulu becomes the desert protective goddess
relations.note: Bilulu is transformed into a desert protective goddess functionally corresponding to the Lamma category.

relations.myth: Ĝirĝire becomes the desert protective god
relations.note: Ĝirĝire is transformed into a desert protective god corresponding functionally to the Alad category.
Hittite scribes sometimes used Sumerographic LAMMA for an Anatolian tutelary deity identified with Inara.
